biotools.summary: DrugDomain 2.0 is a database linking protein domains to ligands and drugs based on structural data from the Protein Data Bank, enhanced with AlphaFold predictions. It catalogues domain-ligand interactions, PTMs, and provides insights into drug target relationships.
